legs.coverage_limits: Exercised: local (non-distributed) responses through the XML path (ReturnFieldsTest), the CSV writer, and the JavaBin writer, for stored string fields, covering explicit exclusions and glob exclusions, plus the leading-hyphen compatibility probe. Not exercised: distributed search, real-time get, the export handler, handler-appended or default fl, alias and transformer interplay, DocValues-only or non-stored fields, and score pseudo-fields. The root check ran with tests excluded (-x test), as the gate specifies.

legs.hyphen_probe: RECORDED (diagnostic only, same disposable probe test at both refs, schema12, one doc with a real stored field named -foo_s plus control field title_s; full serialized responses in evidence). At base 780653ba4e the baseline request returns the document with both fields, and fl=-foo_s FAILS with java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "-". At contributor parent 35db4554284ca0d2ca37eb78ed4c7c7dee599db2 the baseline is identical, and fl=-foo_s returns status 0 with the FULL document (id, -foo_s, title_s). Classification: behavior changed by the implementation. The crash is gone; the parent parses the entry as an exclusion of the field named foo_s, so a stored field whose name literally begins with a hyphen is returned and cannot be excluded through this syntax. No parser error at the parent. No production change made; probe source and outputs are in the evidence only and were never committed or pushed.

legs.testuuid_classification: Coverage-branch test interaction, isolated by four runs at seed 5321CAFE. (1) At contributor parent 35db4554284ca0d2ca37eb78ed4c7c7dee599db2 the class passes 4/4 run alone. (2) At base 780653ba4e9e65052dc7eb7baf77113a6788bbb5 the class passes 4/4 run alone. (3) At the head, testUUID run ALONE passes. (4) At the head, a two-method run of testExclusionResponse + testUUID fails: testExclusionResponse passes first, then testUUID fails with the identical NullPointerException. Mechanism from source: testUUID indexes doc id=101 with a uuid field, queries q=*:*, and asserts every returned document has a String uuid field value; testExclusionResponse commits doc id=5321 (fields id, foo_s, bar_s; no uuid field) into the shared per-class index and never removes it, so the *:* result contains a document with no uuid value. The production implementation is not implicated: the coverage branch diff vs the contributor parent is test-only (+44 lines across the three test files).

summary: The three new response-coverage methods for PR 5321 (SOLR-3191 fl exclusions) all pass at the exact head and all three discriminate under the isExcluded mutation; tidy is clean and the root check passes at the head. The gate fails on one finding: the coverage branch's own new TestJavaBinResponseWriter.testExclusionResponse leaves a committed document in the shared per-class index, which breaks the pre-existing testUUID in the same class whenever the new method runs first (seed 5321CAFE). The defect is in the coverage branch's test code, not in the SOLR-3191 production implementation, which the coverage branch does not touch. No source changes were made or pushed by this gate; the repair belongs to the branch owner (delete the added document or clear the index at the end of the new method).
